signIn.title: Sign-in window
signIn.languageHint: When matching, browsers set to Japanese, Spanish or Chinese get that language. Japan, China, Taiwan and Hong Kong time zones get theirs, and everyone else gets English. Users can always switch.

emailHints.none: Users aren't asked, and your app doesn't get their email.
emailHints.optional: After signing in, users choose whether to share their email with your app.
emailHints.required: After signing in, users must share their email with your app to continue.

brand.label: Brand
brand.hint: Which brand the button and the sign-in window show. Leave as "Default" to use your workspace default brand.

legal.title: Privacy policy & terms of service
legal.shownToVehicleOwners: Displayed to vehicle owners before they grant permissions. Leave blank to skip.
legal.shownToUsers: Displayed to users before they log in. Leave blank to skip.

share.templateIdHint: The number of a permissions template, for example 1.
share.documentsHint: Documents your app can read for each shared vehicle. Users see them in the request before they share.
share.vehiclesHint: Leave blank to let users share any of their vehicles. Others are listed as "Can't be shared", with the reason. Separate values with commas.
